item.description:
SG seller, all ready stock.

🔎Specifications
Weight:
18oz/550ml 295g
24oz/700ml 370g
40oz/1200ml 440g


🔎Features
✅ Premium 304 Stainless Steel Construction
Thrivesteel®️  insulated water bottle is crafted with durable, rust-resistant 304 stainless steel and double-wall vacuum insulation to prevent condensation. Keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours or hot for up to 12 hours — perfect for everyday hydration.

✅ 2-in-1 Smart Drinking Lid
✨ Switch easily between:
- Straw mode for smooth sipping cold drinks
- Chug/flip cap mode for quick hydration or hot beverages
✨ Wide-mouth opening makes it easy to add ice, fruits, or tea leaves.

✅ Safe & Premium Materials
Made with 304 Stainless steel, BPA-free, food-grade materials for safe daily use. No odor, no harmful chemicals — just clean hydration.

✅ 100% Leakproof
Designed with a secure sealing system so you can toss it into your bag without worrying about leaks or spills.

✅ No Sweat Exterior
Double-wall insulation prevents condensation — keeps your hands and bags dry even with icy drinks.

✅Stylish & Durable Finish
Scratch-resistant matte powder coating for a modern minimalist look. Suitable for:
🏋️ Gym | 🏢 Office | 🚗 Travel | 🏕️ Hiking | 🎒 Daily use


⭐ Why Customers Love It
✔ Keeps drinks cold 24H / hot 12H
✔ Dual lid (straw + chug) for convenience
✔ Leakproof for travel safety
✔ Premium stainless steel durability
✔ Sleek unisex design


📌Usage & Care
✔️ Wash after use & keep dry to prevent odor and stains
✔️ Clean with soft cloth / sponge + mild detergent
✔️ Preheat / pre-cool ♨️❄️ with hot/cold water 5–10 mins
❌ No carbonated or acidic drinks (may corrode & leak)
❌ No impact, metal scrubbers or hard brushes
❌ Not suitable for refrigerator use (may affect material, seal & cause cracking)
